chapter_name: Chapter 18: Composition: Letter and Paragraph Writing
learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will learn how to structure coherent paragraphs and draft informal letters to friends and family with proper formatting.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 You have so many great ideas in your head, but how do you share them with the world? Whether you are writing a fun letter to a friend or describing your favorite pet, structuring your thoughts is the key to becoming an amazing writer!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A good paragraph is like a hamburger! The top bun is the 'Topic Sentence' (tells what you are writing about). The meat and veggies are the 'Detail Sentences' (facts, descriptions). The bottom bun is the 'Closing Sentence' (wraps it up).
examples_or_templates: Topic: Dogs make the best pets.
Details: They are loyal. They love to play. They protect your house.
Closing: That is why I love dogs so much.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Informal letters are written to friends and family. They have a strict 5-part structure on the left side of the page: 1. Sender's Address, 2. Date, 3. Salutation (Dear...), 4. Body of the letter, 5. Closing (Yours lovingly,).
examples_or_templates:
Format: 
[Address]
[Date]
Dear [Name],
[Your message goes here...]
Yours lovingly,
[Your Name]

lesson_modules.teaching_content: When writing a paragraph or letter, use transition words to connect your ideas smoothly so your writing doesn't sound like a robot. Words like First, Then, Next, and Finally help show the order of events.
examples_or_templates: **First**, we went to the zoo. **Next**, we saw the lions. **Finally**, we ate ice cream.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ In a paragraph, what do we call the sentence that introduces the main idea?
❓ Where do you write the date in an informal letter?
options: In the middle of the body

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Arrange these sentences into a logical paragraph order: 1. Finally, she ate it all. 2. Mary made a sandwich. 3. First, she took two slices of bread. 4. Next, she added cheese and tomato.
subjective_practice.hint: Look for the sequence words: First, Next, Finally. The introductory sentence goes at the top!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write a suitable Salutation and Closing for a letter to your uncle.
subjective_practice.hint: Salutation is how you say hello (Dear...), Closing is how you say goodbye (Yours...).

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write a 'Topic Sentence' for a paragraph about your favorite festival.
subjective_practice.hint: Make a strong opening statement. For example: 'Diwali is my favorite festival of the year.'

activity_or_assignment.title: ✉️ The Surprise Mail Delivery
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write a short informal letter to your best friend telling them about a funny thing that happened this week. Use the proper 5-part format. Fold it, write their name on the outside, and actually hand it to them the next time you see them!

chapter_summary: ⭐ A paragraph has three main parts: Topic Sentence, Detail Sentences, and a Closing Sentence.
⭐ An informal letter includes Address, Date, Salutation, Body, and Closing.
⭐ Connecting words (First, Next, Finally) help your ideas flow smoothly.
